tier_selection_rule: ez-wo15b-skyrme-massfit-prereg-v4-tier-rule: a parameter is identifiable when a 2% step inside its bounds moves the mean binding energy of the probe set by at least 50.0 keV. The frozen subset is every identifiable parameter in the declared fittable set, minus one member of any pair whose sensitivity vectors correlate above 0.98 — the weaker of the pair by mean absolute effect, so the surviving parameter is the one the data constrains better. The subset is labelled with the named tier it matches, or PARTIAL_<tier> when it is a proper subset. Selection uses identifiability alone; no objective value participates, and the rule can only remove parameters, never add them
